verdict_reason: No physical Mentra Live device, paired phone, or human pilot subject exists in this environment. No substitute, synthetic, or corpus audio was relabelled as Mentra audio.

WS1_live_routing_equivalence.conclusion: The WS1 envelope is exactly the offline evaluator. Essentially all remaining live/offline divergence is the receiver's 200 ms detector cadence, not the routing implementation.

WS2_first_word_retention.measurement_class: gate-exposure proxy (mean applied gain over labelled word spans), NOT ASR word error

selection_rule.objective: maximise first_token_retention pass rate under the LIVE (200 ms held) probability source
selection_rule.constraint_leakage: bystander_word_exposure pass rate must not exceed the A_balanced/preroll=0 baseline by more than 2.0 percentage points
selection_rule.constraint_delay: added algorithmic delay from pre-roll must be <= 150 ms
selection_rule.tie_break: lowest added delay, then lowest bystander exposure

g3_comparison.note: G3's number was measured on the OFFLINE dense probability source. G4 reproduces it there and shows the LIVE receiver's own figure is far worse.

WS3_live_offline_parity.conclusion: The WS1 envelope is exactly the offline evaluator. Essentially all remaining live/offline divergence is the receiver's 200 ms detector cadence, not the routing implementation.
